same_pid_jit_object_verification.scope: Actual executable bytes from the same owned process sampled for CPU self time, captured only after sampling; original Object provenance exact. No timing scores or hardware retirement counts.

complete_instruction_binding.scope: Every executable byte matches its genuine Object except explicitly decoded BL relocations, whose actual destinations must equal captured named JIT functions in the same PID. No code is executed from an Object.

interpretation.sample_scope: Warm checked-call residence includes output reset/drop. Statistical self time is not an exact formal timer fraction, hardware retired instructions/IPC/cache/traffic measurement or a speedup forecast.

interpretation.selected_next_work: Keep existing transpose owner, preparation/finish, source fees, spans, allocation and publication. Replace the native materialized transpose ordinal loop by dynamic two-by-two exact-bit SIMD tiles with row/column induction and bounded scalar tails. This removes per-cell dynamic quotient/remainder without adding a cross-operation loan or changing source semantics. Reuse the same emitter in generator transposes.
